STRICT_CONTEMPORANEOUS_REPLAY.meaning: All decision-critical facts, assumptions, valuation, quote, corporate-action, portfolio, benchmark and universe inputs were available under a contemporaneous rule version.

RETROSPECTIVE_POLICY_REPLAY.meaning: The data and execution chain is PIT-safe enough to test a policy, but the rule version was registered after the decision date.

NOT_PIT_SAFE.meaning: At least one decision-critical input, valuation, execution, benchmark, universe or survivorship requirement cannot be proven under the declared cutoff policy.

information_cutoff.decision_clock: Each decision is evaluated at the close of its SSE session.
information_cutoff.input_rule: Every fact, filing, quote, benchmark level, assumption and rule version used by a decision must have available_at <= decision_at.
information_cutoff.late_or_corrected_data: Late or corrected data cannot be used before its first verified availability time; it only reopens research.
information_cutoff.publication_precision: A date-only publication uses an exclusive next-day upper bound in China Standard Time.
information_cutoff.future_price_rule: Future prices may be used only by the execution ledger after a decision has already been frozen; they must never enter the decision input.

execution_contract.cash: cash-only, no leverage, no shorting, explicit fees and taxes before fill
execution_contract.suspension: an absent stock session must not be filled at a stale price
execution_contract.price_limit: missing or invalid daily limits block the order
execution_contract.liquidity: daily-bar results are research assumptions unless order-book or volume evidence supports the fill binding
execution_contract.corporate_actions: record-date entitlement; ex-date and payment-date handled separately; bonuses locked until listing; no double count
execution_contract.fees: dated statutory components plus an explicitly declared broker-commission scenario; early-SSE rules without a verified basis are UNSUPPORTED

walk_forward.minimum_requirement: A walk-forward result may be produced only after a strict or explicit retrospective admission with a frozen approved value model for every scored session.
forbidden: parameter search using validation or sealed-test outcomes
current assumptions backfilled into past decision dates
gross experiment returns labelled validated strategy performance
